description:
Card and relic statistics in the game's hover tips.

[h2]Statistics[/h2]
[list]
[*]Win rate difference against the A10 average, in percentage points
[*]Pick rate, overall and for the current act
[*]Run and offer counts
[/list]
Available in rewards, shops and card inspection.

[h2]Data[/h2]
Ascension 10, matched to party size and game version. Loaded on demand and cached locally. Pick-rate colours use the overall average, weighted by offers.
